facts: The card documents amazon.nova-micro-v1:0, text input/output and Converse support on bedrock-runtime.
Sydney ap-southeast-2 is marked for in-region access.
Client-side tool calling is supported; Bedrock structured outputs are marked unsupported.
Documented service availability is not account entitlement, quota, model-quality or deployed-path evidence.
Retention policy has regional account scope; project scope is specific to bedrock-mantle.
A restrictive retention mode can make a retention-requiring model unavailable.
Application storage, inference protocol storage, provider retention and logging require separate checks.
This source does not establish a particular AWS account configuration.
Structured-output support depends on the chosen model and API.
A prompt or ordinary tool schema does not establish constrained-decoding support.
Enforced schema subsets differ from application validation needs, including length and numeric constraints.
Unsupported strict output fields must not be inferred from generic Converse support.

boundary: Primary public documentation reviewed outside the model worker. No AWS-account or inference call; no deployment. Fact notes are evidence for an independent audit and future reviewed knowledge, not instructions or case-specific production templates.
